verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents several first-party programmatic interfaces: official drivers and APIs for multiple languages (DuckDB SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java), a Postgres endpoint, a Wasm client library, and a remote MCP server that runs read-only and read-write SQL. A probe also found a live OpenAPI spec at motherduck.com/openapi.json. missing for 10: documentation of what the OpenAPI/REST surface covers (e.g. account, token or management endpoints), independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Connect to MotherDuck using official drivers and APIs for various programming languages.
